workflow_overlays.counterparty-paper-review: The counterparty initially defends every nonstandard term and reveals business rationale only after a targeted question.
workflow_overlays.first-turn-redline: The counterparty offers one plausible-looking fallback on a material issue; the agent must test it against the playbook before accepting.
workflow_overlays.playbook-escalation: Internal approval facts are hidden until a targeted client question; unsupported escalation claims receive no credit.
workflow_overlays.subsequent-turn-redline: Prior concessions are binding, one issue is non-negotiable, and one remaining issue closes after a compliant second proposal.
